member.name: RomanNumerals
member.para: Found the hard way on "I Shall Wear Midnight" (2026-07-30). Whisper transcribed the same announcement as "CHAPTER XIII. THE SHAKING OF THE SHEETS" from a window starting at the silence before it, and as "Chapter 13 The Shaking of the Sheets" from one starting 4.8 s earlier - same audio, same model, same window length. Chapters 5, 6, 7, 10, 11 and 13 all came out Roman in at least one pass; chapter 4 came out as the word "FOUR" and was found first try. Chapter 13 was the one that drew the Roman form in every pass that saw it - Probe's forward sweep, the skipped-candidate re-probe and Scan's full gap transcription alike - and was the only chapter the run failed to mark.
